$comment: Machine-readable companion to docs/references-and-smart-fields.md. Regexes are Python 're' syntax. All token delimiters are literal; the first closing delimiter after an opener ends the token; an opener with no closer is literal text.

notes: The body is not trimmed: {{ x }} looks up ' x '.
A BC field name that contains '.' can't be written literally. Use the normalised name: lower-case, keeping only [a-z0-9] ("Sell-to Customer No." -> selltocustomerno).
Intermediate path segments must be 'reference' SmartField definitions. Only the last segment may fall back to a BC field name.
Only the root may carry an [index].
The format is the text after the first ';' in the body.
The ';' that separates the format is found at top level, ignoring text inside {{...}}, inside double quotes and inside parentheses.
A space must separate if/elseif/for from their parameter; an unknown tag is kept as literal text.
{#for#} iterates records only (reference array, single reference, dotted relation); a value array produces nothing.
A {#for#} without a matching {#endfor#} drops the block and all text after it.

tokens.scanOrder: At each position the earliest opener among '{{', '[[', '[@', '{#' wins; the token then ends at the first matching closer.

resolutionPipeline: SmartControls {#if#}/{#for#} are expanded (conditions: {{}} then [[]] then SmartFilter; SmartDates and aggregates are NOT evaluated in conditions)
SmartDates [@...@] are evaluated (any {{}} inside is resolved first)
Aggregates sum/avg/min/max/count({{list}}[, rowExpr]) are reduced to invariant numbers anywhere in the text
{{...}} selective substitution: scalars are replaced; references, reference arrays and unresolvable tokens are kept verbatim; substituted values are JSON-escaped
SmartFormulas [[...]] are evaluated only if no {{}} in the text segment is unresolvable; a failing formula is kept verbatim

Text segment = the step's serialized configuration between SmartControl tags (the whole configuration when it has no {#...#} tags). Unresolvable = unknown root, or dotted token whose root is not a reference; a bare reference token or an unknown field under a valid reference does not count.

unresolvedBehaviour.unknownToken: kept verbatim, no error, not written to the execution log
unresolvedBehaviour.referenceTokenInText: kept verbatim (only selector-type keys consume references)
unresolvedBehaviour.invalidFormat: unformatted value (a BLOB/Media field with a non-binary, non-escape suffix renders empty)
unresolvedBehaviour.missingRecord: fields resolve to empty or default values

publishCheck.check: Every {{X_...}} in any configuration string, where X is the text before the first '_', must equal (case-sensitive) the slug of some step in the flow

builtInTokens.name: today
builtInTokens.description: Today's date, formatted in the session format. Use {{today;9}} for ISO.

builtInTokens.name: workdate
builtInTokens.description: The work date of the session that started the execution (the current work date in design-time previews).

builtInTokens.name: currentDateTime
builtInTokens.description: Current date-time, formatted in the session format.

builtInTokens.name: currentUser
builtInTokens.description: User record of the session that runs the step (usually the job queue user), e.g. {{currentUser.username}}.

builtInTokens.name: credential.username
builtInTokens.description: HTTP Request body only, when a credential is selected; replaced (XML-escaped) at send time.

builtInTokens.name: credential.password
builtInTokens.description: HTTP Request body only, when a credential is selected; replaced (XML-escaped) at send time.

formatSuffixes.integer: BC standard format number, e.g. 9 = XML/invariant (ISO dates, '.' decimal)
formatSuffixes.formatString: BC Format() string, e.g. <Year4>-<Month,2>-<Day,2> or <Precision,2:2><Standard Format,0>
notes: The inline suffix takes precedence over the format of a 'value' SmartField definition.
Binary tokens only affect BLOB, Media or MediaSet fields reached through a 'value' SmartField definition (not the BC field-name fallback); on anything else they do nothing.
xmlEscape escapes & < > " ' (not idempotent).
A text value with a format is parsed as Date, then Decimal, then Boolean, then DateTime; the first type that parses is formatted.

A configuration value that is exactly one {{root.Field}} (root = reference, Field = value definition on a BLOB/Media/MediaSet field, no suffix) is passed as raw bytes to HTTP Request body and Insert/Modify Record BLOB fields.
Next release (not in 27.0.39): binary step outputs keep their bytes. In 27.0.39 every step output is text.

slug.uniqueness: whole flow (all branches); auto-generation compares case-insensitively, renaming compares exactly
generation: transliterate ä->ae ö->oe ü->ue Ä->Ae Ö->Oe Ü->Ue ß->ss é/è/ê/ë->e á/à/â->a ñ->n ç->c
PascalCase: non-[A-Za-z0-9] characters are word boundaries and are dropped; the first character of each word is upper-cased
strip leading non-letters; cut to 20 characters
collision -> append 2, 3, ... (base shortened to keep <= 20 characters)
slug.renameRewrite: In every string in every step configuration, the literal '{{<old>_' is replaced by '{{<new>_' (editor only; hand-edited JSON is not rewritten)

messages.rejected: The slug "%1" cannot be applied. A slug must start with a letter, contain only letters, digits or hyphens (no underscore), be at most 20 characters long, and be unique within the flow.

outputReference.notes: Trigger output keys are cut to 30 characters (output name effectively 22); reference the truncated form.

id.description: Upper-case GUID without braces; unique across steps and edges. Notes use the same format.

level.description: Nesting depth (number of edges[ segments on the path). Written but never read; always derived from position.

customIconUrl.description: Copied from configuration.customIconUrl when the configuration is saved.

status.description: Display-only execution counters; omit them in authored flows.

note.htmlNote: The editor sanitises html when a note is edited.

smartFieldDefs.location: flow root key 'smartFieldDefs'. Only the flow's own definitions are used at runtime.

referenceDef.key: optional string: comma-joined field NAMES of a key on the target table
referenceDef.relation: array of { target: <field no. on target>, type: 'field'|'const'|'filter', value: <source field no.> | <literal> | <BC filter> }

messages.nameRequired: A SmartField must have a name.
messages.nameTaken: A SmartField named %1 already exists on this table. Choose a different name.

notes: type and relation[].type are matched case-insensitively; a definition with another type is dropped.
A relation entry with an unknown type is dropped together with all entries after it.
Each relation target field may appear once; later duplicates are ignored.
'const' is an exact match on Text/Code target fields and a filter on other types; 'field' calculates a source FlowField first.
If 'key' no longer matches a key on the target table, the primary key is used.

operators.meaning: power; evaluated left-to-right at runtime - use parentheses

smartFormula.unaryMinus: Not supported at runtime directly after another operator (2*-3 gives -3), including substituted negative values ({{a}}*{{b}} with b=-3). Wrap the operand: 2*(-3), {{a}}*({{b}}).

functions.name: round
functions.meaning: round(value, decimals); decimals may be negative

aggregateRules: A value-array list takes no rowExpr.
A reference list needs a rowExpr (except count); the rowExpr refers to the row through the same path.
Blank or unresolved rows are skipped; an empty or missing list gives 0.
sum/avg/count with a braced first argument are always aggregates (a non-list gives 0); min/max with two arguments stay scalar unless the first argument is a list.
smartFormula.defaultFormat: <Standard Format,9> is appended unless the format already contains '<Standard Format' or '<Integer'. A bare standard-format number such as 9 is NOT supported (printed literally).
editorErrors: A SmartField in the formula is missing its closing "}}".
The aggregate %1() needs a {{list}} as its first argument.

functions.name: dateadd
functions.notes: day/week/month/year keep the time of day; n is rounded to an integer

functions.name: calc
functions.notes: invariant letters D W M Y C first, then session letters

functions.name: datediff
functions.notes: day: calendar days; week: days div 7; month/year: calendar month/year numbers (day ignored); hour/minute: decimal

smartDate.formatOtherwise: BC Format() string. A bare standard-format number such as 9 is NOT supported (printed literally).
errors: The SmartDate function %1() got the wrong number of arguments.
"%1" is not a valid date or time.
smartDate.literalNotes: '/' and '-' also work as separators for DD.MM.YYYY; day and month are swapped only when the second number is > 12.
smartDate.quotesOptional: Quotes around the unit and the date formula are optional; JSON-escaped quotes (\") are un-escaped.

rules: Both operands numeric (session culture) -> numeric comparison; otherwise case-sensitive text comparison.
Operands are trimmed; quotes are not stripped (except '' meaning empty).
Each side of & and | must be parenthesised, with at most two conditions per level.
A condition that can't be evaluated is false.
Not converted into a BC table filter; evaluated in memory.
editorMessages: The SmartFilter expression "%1" cannot be parsed into the builder. Please edit it manually or clear it.
The SmartFilter expression "%1" combines more than two conditions at the top level. Wrap each pair in parentheses so the builder can load it.
A value contains & | ( or ) outside a token – the filter may not evaluate as written.

selector.description: Exactly one braced token naming a reference, a reference array, an indexed element or a dotted relation path; used by selector-type configuration keys.
